<!-- Thanks for contributing to LayoutProof. Please complete the checklist. -->

## Description

What does this pull request change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New detection rule
- [ ] New/improved automatic fix
- [ ] Report / rendering change
- [ ] Documentation / engineering
- [ ] Other

## Verification

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by positive **and** negative tests
- [ ] Any fixed bug is covered by a regression test
- [ ] No thresholds were lowered, no tests deleted, no output fabricated
- [ ] Source files remain read-only; fixes write new files
- [ ] JSON output still validates against `report/schema.json`
- [ ] Unverified platforms/features are documented, not claimed
